staticCause.workflow: Only TransactionDispatchCancelled enters finishCancelled in the step catch. An in-flight HostStepFailed instead calls failWith despite a concurrent cancel signal.
staticCause.database: failTask allows CANCELLING in its update predicate, so it can overwrite the authoritative stop request with FAILED.
staticCause.proposedFixNotYetImplemented: Transaction catch should honor pending cancellation; persistence should atomically preserve cancellation precedence when the signal is delayed. Retain the unknown host result and order identity; do not describe task cancellation as external order cancellation or release dedupe/quota.
